description: Tier-C company directory (Feature #01, M7): every company name from interview/data/companies.json (the 615 across 5 CompanyType groups) mapped to its CompanyType->archetype default, so any name resolves to a relevant generic simulation - never a company-not-found dead-end. type->archetype: service->mass_service, product->product, analytics->analytics, core->core, general->mass_service. Generated from companies.json; regenerate when that file changes.
